en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus Bin Abdul Rahman, from Al Hassan Bin Al Sarry, from Jabir Bin Yazeed Al Ju’fy who said, ‘I asked Abu Ja’farasws about something from the Tawheed (Oneness). So heasws said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Blessed are His<sup>azwj</sup> Names which He<sup>azwj</sup> is called with, and Exalted is He<sup>azwj</sup>, Lofty is His<sup>azwj</sup> Being. He<sup>azwj</sup> is Unique by the Oneness in His<sup>azwj</sup> Uniqueness. Then Flowed it upon His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures.
So Heazwj is One, Samad, Holy. Everything worships Himazwj and turns towards Himazwj, and Heazwj has Capacious Knowledge of everything’.

quarantined.en.sarwar: not verbatim: rejoined parts diverge at char 498 (orig 1715 chars, got 498): 'geofallthings.”Al-Kulaynihassaidthatthis' vs 'geofallthings.”'
